instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to learn how Anglo-Saxon society had evolved since the Romans.

atoms.b: When the Anglo-Saxons arrived in Britain in the 6th century, they were not yet organised enough to make their own ((++coins swords)).
This changed as the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms became ((++richer poorer)) and more powerful.
Coastal kingdoms like Kent were able to become very rich through trade with other ((++European Asian)) kingdoms.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: With this new wealth and power, Anglo-Saxon kingdoms were finally able to build proper stone buildings and roads. They also built many towns, churches and monasteries.

In these newly built monasteries, monks started writing religious texts and chronicles. These are some of the best sources we have on the Anglo-Saxons. Many of these were illuminated texts, which were highly decorated with paintings and precious metals.
